name: todoodle
rules: Follow the design: its repository layout, file names, named settings, exported interfaces, and the exact UI text the PRD and design specify.
Work through tasks.md in order. Write the tests the design lists and make them pass. Do not delete or weaken tests to make them pass.
Before you finish, run the project's build, typecheck and test commands, and fix failures.
Do not ask questions; there is nobody to answer. Make a reasonable decision, note it in `NOTES.md`, and continue.

Commit after each task in tasks.md is done, with the message `story {{ID}} task N: <the task's title>`, so finished work is never left uncommitted. When the story is complete, make a final commit `story {{ID}}: {{TITLE}}` with anything left.
